subject: Confidential: Pre-PIP trajectory stabilization plan for Dylan Brooks
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Confidential: Pre-PIP trajectory stabilization plan for Dylan Brooks

Hi Monica / Laura,

I wanted to loop you both in on a sensitive coaching situation before I have the one-on-one with Dylan next week. Over the last 8 weeks Dylan's deliverables on the inference runtime project have slipped (missed two sprint commitments, several PRs with quality rework). I've documented examples in the attached "mgr_72hr_action_notes.pdf".

My goal here is to avoid an immediate PIP if we can (both from a team morale and legal/compliance angle), but I also need HR's recommendations on documentation, timeboxed expectations, and what language is appropriate in the initial coaching conversation. Specifically:
- Is a 30/60 day stabilization plan sufficient given the pattern?
- What specific documentation do we need in the thread to satisfy HR/audit (and still be constructive)?
- Any mandatory HR steps I need to complete before the manager-facing conversation?

I've sketched a manager checklist and proposed checkpoints in the attached notes. I'm happy to run this as a joint call with HR present for the coaching conversation if you recommend that.

Appreciate quick guidance — I'd like to send a manager-facing invite and draft to Dylan's calendar by Wednesday.

Thanks,
Connor
Manager, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachment: mgr_72hr_action_notes.pdf (pdf)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Confidential: Pre-PIP trajectory stabilization plan for Dylan Brooks

Connor —

Thanks for the clear write-up and for keeping this confidential. I reviewed your notes. High-level guidance: we prefer a documented, timebound remediation path before moving to a formal PIP unless there's gross misconduct. A 30/60 approach is reasonable here given the performance pattern, but we should define objective acceptance criteria (deliverable targets, quality gates, and communication expectations).

I've attached our standard "coaching_template_v2.docx" which contains a recommended header (issue summary, baseline examples, expected outcomes, metrics, manager checkpoints, and escalation conditions). For this case I'd recommend:
- 30-day primary checkpoint with a concrete deliverable (e.g., complete refactor PR X with no more than 2 substantive review comments)
- Weekly 1:1s with explicit agenda and notes saved in the HRIS case (HRIS-7329)
- A final 60-day review; if criteria not met, move to formal PIP escalation (documented).

Do NOT copy performance language from the attachment verbatim into a calendar invite. Keep the initial conversation constructive and behavior-focused; save the detailed criteria in the coaching doc and HRIS. If you want HR on the first coaching meeting, I can join — that often helps set clear expectations and protects both parties.

I'll also add a support checklist (support_checklist.xlsx) that you can use to track short-term mitigations (paired reviews, reduced scope, additional QA cycles).

If this sounds good I'll:
1) Open the HRIS case (HRIS-7329) and attach your notes + our template.
2) Draft a manager-facing coaching email you can send to Dylan (or we can deliver in the meeting).
3) Join the first coaching call if you want HR present (Wed/Thu preferable for me).

Monica
Sr. HR Business Partner
Redwood Inference

Attachment: coaching_template_v2.docx (docx), support_checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Confidential: Pre-PIP trajectory stabilization plan for Dylan Brooks

Monica —

That guidance is perfect, thank you. Please open the HRIS case and attach the docset you mentioned. I'd like HR present for the first meeting — could you join Thursday at 10am PT? If that's tight, Wed afternoon also works.

I've drafted a short script/agenda for the coaching meeting and a separate private manager checklist. I've attached the manager checklist as a PDF (mgr_72hr_action_notes.pdf) in this thread; below is the draft agenda I plan to use in the meeting if HR is present:

Dylan coaching meeting (draft agenda)
- 5m: purpose and constructive intent; non-punitive starting point
- 10m: specific examples (focus on observable facts)
- 10m: manager expectations (30/60 goals, acceptance criteria)
- 10m: support offer (paired reviews, reduced scope, learning resources)
- 5m: confirm follow-ups and schedule weekly check-ins

I'll hold the calendar invite as private and include you both once HRIS is updated.

Connor
Manager, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Confidential: Pre-PIP trajectory stabilization plan for Dylan Brooks

Connor / Monica —

Appreciate the proactive approach. A couple of leadership asks before the meeting:
- Make the 30/60 acceptance criteria as objective as possible (no subjective phrasing like "improve focus"). Tie to deliverables and measurable review outcomes.
- Make sure you document any accommodations made (reduced scope, extra QA) and the expected timeline for those.
- Keep copies of the weekly 1:1 notes in the HRIS case (this is important if we need to escalate).

If HR agrees and the first 30-day check hits the exits in your favor, we'll leave this as a coaching closed loop. If not, we'll schedule a follow-up review with People Ops and me for next steps.

If useful I can provide a short note to the EMEA engineering leadership about the plan (we should keep cross-team communication minimal until this is resolved).

Laura Bennett
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Confidential: Pre-PIP trajectory stabilization plan for Dylan Brooks

Connor —

HRIS case HRIS-7329 created and materials attached. I've uploaded the completed coaching_template_v2 and support_checklist to the case and set the first HR attendance for Thu 10 Jun 2026 10:00am PT (invite sent to you and Dylan). The case link: https://hris.redwood.ai/cases/HRIS-7329 (internal).

Next steps for you (manager):
- Send a brief meeting invite (private) to Dylan that states "1:1 to discuss role expectations and support" — avoid legal wording in the invite body.
- Save meeting notes to HRIS within 24 hours after each check-in.
- Use the manager checklist in the attached PDF to capture evidence and next-step commitments.

I'll join the first call and will follow up with an intake template for the weekly notes. If the 30-day checkpoint is not met we'll prepare for a formal PIP conversation with documented criteria and an escalation timeline.

Thanks — Monica
Sr. HR Business Partner
Redwood Inference

Attachment: coaching_template_v2.docx, support_checklist.xlsx
